# Autobound

> Autobound is B2B signal data infrastructure. One Signal API returns 700+ signals across 35 signal types for companies and 270M+ contacts: news, SEC filings, hiring, job changes, funding, buyer intent and more. Delivery: REST API, MCP server, GCS push and flat files.

Autobound sells signal data. It is not an email writer and not a Chrome extension.

## Get data with the Signal API

- Base URL: https://signals.autobound.ai
- Auth: `X-API-KEY: <key>` header (or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`). Every /v1/ route needs a key. There is no anonymous endpoint.
- Free key: 1,000 free credits at signup: https://signalapi.autobound.ai/signup
- Search returns the last 50 days by default. Search `limit` is 1-100; enrich `limit` is 1-500.
- Rate limit: 300 requests per minute for each account.
- API reference: https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference

Endpoints:

- `POST /v1/companies/search`: companies with signals of the given types (2 credits per company returned). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/searchcompanies
- `POST /v1/contacts/search`: contacts with signals (2 credits per contact returned). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/searchcontacts
- `POST /v1/companies/enrich`: all signals for one company by domain, name or LinkedIn URL (2 credits per signal returned). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/enrichcompany
- `POST /v1/contacts/enrich`: all signals for one person by email or LinkedIn URL (2 credits per signal returned). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/enrichcontact
- `GET /v1/signals/types`: every signal type and subtype (free). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/listsignaltypes
- `GET /v1/signals/{signal_id}`: one signal (free). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/getsignalbyid
- `POST /v1/buyer-intent/companies`: companies with buyer intent for given topics (1 credit per company-topic row). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/searchbuyerintentcompanies
- `POST /v1/monitoring/add`: add companies or contacts to a monitoring pool (10 credits per new record). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/addtomonitoringpool
- `GET /v1/credits`: credit balance (free). https://autobound-api.readme.io/reference/getcredits

Example: all news signals for one company.

```bash
curl -X POST https://signals.autobound.ai/v1/companies/enrich \
  -H "X-API-KEY: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"domain":"stripe.com","signal_types":["news"],"limit":10}'
```

Example: companies that announced job cuts (news subtype decreases_headcount_by).

```bash
curl -X POST https://signals.autobound.ai/v1/companies/search \
  -H "X-API-KEY: YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"signal_types":["news"],"signal_subtypes":["decreases_headcount_by"],"limit":10}'
```

## Free data on this site

Each table shows its newest rows for free. All counts are free. The Signal API returns every row, the full history and the filters.

## Credits and pricing

- 1,000 free credits at signup.
- Search: 2 credits per entity returned. Enrich: 2 credits per signal returned. Email verification: 1 credit per email verified.
- A request with no results is free.
- Credit packs (one-time purchases):
  - Starter: 1,900 credits for $19
  - Growth: 5,444 credits for $49
  - Scale: 19,867 credits for $149
  - Pro: 83,167 credits for $499
  - Business: 288,667 credits for $1,299
  - Enterprise: 1,249,750 credits for $4,999
